title: [3.3 beta1] Feedback on unattended exports
symptom: In unattended export, the text is so long that the checkbox to delete the entry does not show, and there are string issues: empty parenthesis and nothing before colon. Also, the source string for unattended export seems different from manual export, causing translation discrepancies.
fix: The checkbox issue was fixed by a commit, but the string improvements were not fully addressed.
